meta.title: Nuclear charge radii and electromagnetic moments (ground states)
meta.evaluation: ENSDF/AME2020/NUBASE2020/Angeli-Marinova/Stone by field; row cutoff dates retained; fission yields JEFF 3.1.1; beta spectra Betashape 2.2
meta.radius_source: Angeli & Marinova, At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 99, 69 (2013), as distributed by IAEA LiveChart
meta.moment_source: Stone, IAEA INDC(NDS)-0658 (2014) and later updates, as distributed by IAEA LiveChart
meta.note: Marginal uncertainties only; evaluated covariances between isotopes are not published. kind u = state not resolved in the source. Spin-0 moment entries and the neutron radius (a mean-square value) are excluded as inconsistent. Acknowledge IAEA and the original evaluations.
